June 11, 2026

TurboFlow Adopts Chainlink for XAU, BTC, and ETH Continuous Prediction Markets

TurboFlow and Chainlink announced that TurboFlow had adopted Chainlink to power new continuous prediction markets for XAU, BTC, and ETH.

Original source: Advanced markets required advanced infrastructure · By TurboFlow

TurboFlow official X post

Advanced markets required advanced infrastructure.

With @chainlink, TurboFlow is unlocking fast, accurate, continuous prediction markets for global retail participation.

Everyone gets a seat at TurboFlow.

Predict the outcome today.

Chainlink official X post

NOW: @TurboFlow_xyz adopts Chainlink to power new continuous prediction markets for $XAU, $BTC, and $ETH.

Frequently asked questions

What did TurboFlow and Chainlink announce?

They announced that TurboFlow had adopted Chainlink to power new continuous prediction markets.

Which markets did Chainlink name?

Chainlink's official X post named XAU, BTC, and ETH.

How did TurboFlow describe the prediction markets?

TurboFlow described them as fast, accurate, and continuous prediction markets.

Who did TurboFlow say the markets were for?

TurboFlow said the markets were intended for global retail participation.

When were the official posts published?

TurboFlow and Chainlink published the official X posts on June 11, 2026.
